Fewer Gemini requests, and nutrient lookups that work on free Gemini keys. Install it over 1.0.1; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.2/Spectra.apk)**

### New way to fill in nutrients: Read brand pages
Spectra now finds the product's own pages itself (the brand's site and retailers, via DuckDuckGo or Brave Search) and sends their nutrition text to Gemini with the same prompt as the Ask Gemini button.
- **1 Gemini request per new product** (was up to 4), with no AI web search, so it works on free keys.
- **Exact brand values** from those pages are kept and tagged; anything not published is marked **est.**
- Barcodes no database knows are named by **UPCitemdb** first, or identified from the search results.
- Optional **Brave Search API key** in Targets → Data sources for more reliable page finding.

### Gemini errors and limits
- Spectra now shows **Google's actual reason** when Gemini refuses a request (busy this minute, daily allowance used, or not allowed on your tier).
- **Busy this minute:** waits as long as Google says (up to 30 s), then retries once.
- **Daily allowance used:** tries the other model once (Flash ↔ Flash-Lite).
- **Web search not allowed:** asks again without web search.
- **Test key** checks the key with one small request.

### Switching back
Targets → Data sources → **How new products get their nutrients** → **AI web search** restores the 1.0.1 method at any time. Your data isn't affected either way.
